title: Answer: information is quantum, experienced from within, and meaningful only to consciousness

statements.text: The information of consciousness is quantum information, experienced by the system that holds it. Shannon information measures symbols without meaning, and a symbol without meaning is only a signal, so meaning, the inner semantic side of information, exists only because there is consciousness.

sources.quote: a symbol without meaning is just a signal
P2’: Quantumness of experience: The information theory of consciousness is quantum theory.
